column3: Clears battle state, encounter accumulator, and battle pointers, then selects map encounter tables when enabled.
Accumulates player travel, chooses a nearby encounter point and region, spawns a group, and calls Player_InitBattle.
Spawns the selected boss, initializes turn order and battle state, and calls Player_InitBattle.
Changes the camera to an enemy position for one timed phase, then restores a player-facing preset.
After a turn timer, checks battle completion and rewards or starts the next enemy turn.
Ticks actor statuses, advances the turn-order index, toggles the active side, and starts the turn transition.
Returns the rectangular encounter record containing the supplied X and Y point.
Collects up to six encounter points at a squared distance of 2500 through 8100 and randomly chooses one.
Chooses a group entry, spawns its listed enemies around a point, and sorts their turn order.
